data.narrative:
Generalist AI is a Series B robotics and manufacturing company seeking valuation after raising $500M+ to date. The target operates within a competitive peer set of 9 private companies and 1 public comparable (ticker 277810.KQ). Relevant private peers include Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B Series B), Dexterity ($1.6B Series B), Agile Robots ($1.0B Series C), and Nimble Robotics ($1.0B Series C). The founding team includes Pete Florence (ex-DeepMind, PaLM-E and RT-2 co-creator), Andy Zeng (ex-DeepMind Chief Scientist), and Andrew Barry (ex-Boston Dynamics CTO).

Two valuation methods apply. The Stage-Progression method applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier to the current $2.0B post-money valuation, implying $3.8B. The Peer-Median method derives a $1.3B implied value from a median across four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables, with a peer range of $1.0B to $1.8B.

Triangulating these methods yields a valuation range of $1.1B (low) to $4.4B (high), with a median of $2.6B. The wide spread reflects tension between the company's current $2.0B valuation (above peer median) and peer-based multiples that suggest lower valuations. Key uncertainties include whether the team's technical pedigree and AI capabilities command a premium above robotics sector norms, and revenue traction relative to the capital raised.
